method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Sex Discrimination Act 1984, compilation date 1 November 2025 (includes amendments up to Act No. 45, 2025; register id C2025C00597), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A02868.txt; with the Australian Human Rights Commission Act 1986, Compilation No. 58, compilation date 18 September 2026 (includes amendments up to Act No. 87, 2026; register id C2026C00416), as deposited at ../../../australian-human-rights-commission-act-1986/registers/source-bundle/C2004A03366.txt (ss 3(1), 46P, 46PH(1)(b), 46PO(2), 46PSA only). No regulations set a number this encoding needs.

focus: the positive duty (Part IIA, s 47C, from 13 December 2022) and the harassment, hostile-workplace, victimisation, liability, complaint, time-limit and costs provisions a claimant meets around it

checks.command: l4 run sda-dates.l4; l4 run sda-work.l4; l4 run sda-cases-full.l4; l4 run sda-cases-steps.l4
checks.result: sda-cases-full.l4: 49 written, 49 satisfied; sda-cases-steps.l4: 44 written, 44 satisfied; 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the employee, worker or job seeker on the receiving end: ss 8, 8A, 28A, 28AA, 28AB, 28B(1)-(8), 28M, 47A (with the (3) defence), 47B, 47C(1)-(5), 94 (penalties), 105, 106, 110; AHRC Act ss 3(1)(c), 46P(1), (1A), (2), (3), 46PH(1)(b), 46PO(2), 46PSA(2), (4), (5), (6). Out: sex discrimination itself (ss 5-7D, 14-27, an input), harassment in other areas (ss 28C-28L), the exemptions, s 47C(6)-(8) (compliance is the Commission's judgment), AHRC Act Division 4A (the Commission's powers over the duty holder), the other termination grounds, conciliation and remedies, s 9 reach (assumed), penalty unit values.
seat: the employee, worker or job seeker on the receiving end of the conduct (the individual to whom the Act is applied)
